info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Statements-v1-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Statements Retrieval API allows users to access comprehensive statements for their banking accounts. This endpoint provides detailed financial information, helping consumers track their transactions and manage their finances effectively. It is particularly useful for clients seeking to review past activity for budgeting or auditing purposes. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate financial statement retrieval capabilities into various applications, enhancing user engagement and offering financial insights.

get.description: Fetch the statements associated with a user's account. This endpoint allows users to view their financial statements over a specified period.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving account statements. It should contain all necessary information such as account identifiers, date ranges, and filters that define the statements to be retrieved.

ListBankingAccountsStatementsRequest.description: The request body for retrieving account statements. This should be a string representation of the request data.
